findings.explanation: Claims under Section 9 (including intellectual property infringement and indemnification) are excluded from the liability cap, leaving your financial exposure for those claims completely uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars in the aggregate, inclusive of any claims under Section 9 hereof.

findings.explanation: Payment of the balance is due within 60 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day payment window and negatively impacts your cash flow.
findings.suggested_change: within thirty (30) days of the execution of this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of changes before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause stating 'EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF', claims under Section 9 are excluded from the liability cap, leaving financial exposure completely uncapped; I propose updating this to 'The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars in the aggregate, inclusive of any claims under Section 9 hereof.' - Regarding the relevant clause stating 'within sixty (60) days', payment is due within 60 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day payment window and negatively impacts cash flow; I propose updating this to 'within thirty (30) days of the execution of this Agreement.' Thank you for your consideration. Best regards,
